vt1019017.title: Olympus PEN EED Half Frame 35mm Film Camera F.Zuiko 32mm f1.7 Meter Tested
vt1019017.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1019017.details: Olympus PEN EED 35mm half-frame film camera with the F.Zuiko 32mm f/1.7 lens and a built-in exposure meter, powered by one LR44 battery. Condition per the seller: it has been cleaned, but there are spots of rust and scratches in places and it shows its age; the photos show corrosion on the battery cover and scuffs on the silver parts. The plastic lens cap is loose and comes off easily. The seller checked that the shutter, winding and rewinding, self-timer and exposure meter work; it was not tested with film, so please consider it for use after servicing. Included, as shown in the photos: the camera body, the lens cap and the strap. No battery is included.
vt1019017.why: A used Olympus PEN EED half-frame camera with an F.Zuiko 32mm f/1.7 lens.
vt1019017.perfect: Half-frame film fans and collectors of vintage Olympus cameras.
vt1019017.exp: A pre-owned Olympus PEN EED with the rust, scratches and loose lens cap described above.
vt1019017.cd: Pre-owned with age-related rust and scratches in places, corrosion on the battery cover and scuffs on the silver parts. The plastic lens cap is loose. The seller checked the shutter, winding and rewinding, self-timer and exposure meter; not tested with film. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
